headlines.shortLinkText: A.J. Green has big game as Bengals dominate Dolphins 22-7

headlines.description: Blake Bortles threw for two touchdowns and ran for another as Jacksonville held off a furious Indianapolis Colts rally to win 30-27 in London for the Jaguars' first win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars survive late Colts rally, win 30-27 in London

headlines.description: Matt Ryan shredded Carolina's defense, passing for a team-record 503 yards and four touchdowns, Julio Jones had 12 receptions for a Falcons-record 300 yards, and Atlanta beat the struggling Panth
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan, Jones set records as Falcons beat Panthers 48-33

headlines.description: Brian Hoyer threw for 302 yards and two touchdowns, and the Chicago Bears earned their first win of the season with a 17-14 victory over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hoyer leads way as Bears beat Lions 17-14 for 1st win

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Buffalo took advantage of sloppy, Tom Brady-less New England to hand the Patriots their first home shutout at Gillette Stadium, winning 16-0 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills QB Taylor commanding  in 16-0  win over Patriots

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at New York Jets

headlines.description: Russell Wilson was sharp and efficient despite playing with a sprained knee, throwing three touchdown passes in the Seattle Seahawks' 27-17 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson sharp, throws 3 TDs in Seahawks' 27-17 win over Jets

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw three touchdown passes, including two to tight end Jordan Reed, and the Washington Redskins cashed in on several trips to the red zone to beat the Cleveland Browns 31-20 on Sun
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins thrive in red zone to beat Browns 31-20

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw four touchdown passes, the last to Michael Crabtree with 2:12 left, and the Oakland Raiders beat the previously undefeated Baltimore Ravens 28-27 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr throws 4 TD passes as Raiders beat Ravens 28-27

headlines.description: Will Fuller had a tiebreaking 67-yard punt return for a touchdown and the Houston Texans earned a 27-20 win over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday in their first game without J.J. Watt.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fuller's punt return TD lifts Texans over Titans 27-20

events.name: Denver Broncos at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Paxton Lynch made his NFL debut sooner than expected Sunday, stepping in for injured starter Trevor Siemian to help the Broncos remain unbeaten with a 27-7 victory over the Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos lose Siemian, beat Bucs 27-7 to improve to 4-0

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Tavon Austin returned a punt 47 yards to set up a touchdown with 2:41 to play, and the Rams improved to 3-1 for the first time in a decade with a 17-13 victory over the Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams rally late to beat Cardinals 17-13, Palmer hurt

events.name: New Orleans Saints at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw two touchdown passes in the final 4 minutes, 50 seconds to rally the New Orleans Saints to a stunning 35-34 victory on Sunday against Philip Rivers and the San Diego Chargers, wh
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Saints stun  Chargers in final minutes for 35-34 win

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott ran for 138 yards and a touchdown and Dak Prescott threw for two scores to help the Dallas Cowboys overcome an early 14-point deficit to beat the San Francisco 49ers 24-17 on Sund
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookies Elliott, Prescott lead Cowboys past 49ers 24-17

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw five touchdowns passes for the fifth time in his career and the Pittsburgh Steelers throttled the Kansas City Chiefs 43-14 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roethlisberger has 5 TD passes, Steelers thump Chiefs 43-14

events.name: New York Giants at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Minnesota's defense denied Odell Beckham Jr. all night, forced two turnovers that led to 10 points, and mystified Eli Manning yet again during a 24-10 victory Monday over the New York Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings deny Beckham, mystify Manning in 24-10 win vs. NYG
